{{classSpread}} {{classImage ![greenspeaker](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Applesmacks/NimbleHomebrewProjects/refs/heads/main/Greenspeaker/Greenspeaker.svg) }} # GREENSPEAKER {{note,large,classDetails **Key Stats:** WIL, STR   **Hit Die:** 1d8  **Starting HP:** 13 : **Saves:** WIL+, DEX-   **Armor:** Cloth   **Weapons:** Staves, Wands, Blades : **Starting Gear:** Adventurer’s Garb, Staff, Strange Plant }} {{level **Floral Weapon.** Learn the Thorn Whip cantrip. : **Seed Dice.** When you roll initiative and at the end of each of your turns, gain a d4 Seed Die, then grow all of your other Seed Dice by one. Your max Seed Die size is d12, and you can have a max of STR+1 Seed Dice. : **Chuck Seed.** (1/turn) Free action: Expend a Seed Die. Roll it and deal that much damage to a creature within Reach 6 (ignoring armor). }} {{note,wide **Seed Dice.** When you grow a Seed Die, swap the die for the next larger size. The die size order is d4 -> d6 -> d8 -> d10 -> d12. }} {{level **Mana and Tier 1 Spells.** You unlock Tier 1 Greenspeaker spells and a mana pool to cast them. Max mana is always equal to WIL+LVL, and recharges on a Safe Rest. : **Savage Bloom.** When you deal damage with a spell, you may expend a Seed Die. If you do, the spell deals an additional 1d(SD) damage. : **Cultivate Flora.** (1/turn) Action: Grow one of your Seed Dice up to two sizes. }} {{level **Subclass**. Choose a Greenspeaker subclass. : **One With the Grove.** Advantage on Naturecraft checks related to flora. You can communicate simple thoughts with plants and make basic requests of them. }} {{level **Horticulture.** Choose 1 Horticulture ability. : **Tier 2 Spells.** You may now cast tier 2 Greenspeaker spells. : **Key Stat Increase**. +1 WIL or STR. }} {{note,wide **Commune.** You may choose different Greenspeaker options whenever you tend to plants or meditate in a natural space during a Safe Rest. }} {{pageNumber}} \page {{level **Turning of the Seasons.** Choose 2 Seasonal Adaptations. When you roll Inititative, choose a Seasonal Adaptation you know to be active for the encounter. : **Secondary Stat Increase**. +1 DEX or INT. }} {{level **Tier 3 Spells.** You may now cast tier 3 Greenspeaker spells. : **Bark Skin.** When you Defend, you may expend a Seed Die to increase your Defense by STR×2 until the start of your next turn. : **Horticulture (2).** Choose a 2nd Horticulture ability. }} {{level **Subclass**. Gain your Greenspeaker subclass feature. : **Savage Bloom (2).** Your Savage Bloom bonus is now 2d(SD). }} {{level **Tier 4 Spells.** You may now cast tier 4 Greenspeaker spells. : **Key Stat Increase**. +1 WIL or STR. }} {{level **Horticulture (3).** Choose a 3rd Horticulture ability. : **Secondary Stat Increase**. +1 DEX or INT. }} {{level **Tier 5 Spells.** You may now cast tier 5 Greenspeaker spells. : **Turning of the Seasons (2).** Choose a 3rd Seasonal Adaptation. }} {{level **Subclass**. Gain your Greenspeaker subclass feature. }} {{level **Horticulture (4).** Choose a 4th Horticulture ability. : **Savage Bloom (3).** Your Savage Bloom bonus is now 3d(SD). : **Key Stat Increase**. +1 WIL or STR. }} {{level **Root Stride.** When you Cultivate Growth, move up to half your Speed for free. : **Secondary Stat Increase**. +1 DEX or INT. }} {{level **Turning of the Seasons (3).** Choose a 4th Seasonal Adaptation. }} {{level **Subclass**. Gain your Greenspeaker subclass feature. }} {{level **Horticulture (4).** Choose a 4th Horticulture ability. : **Key Stat Increase**. +1 WIL or STR. }} {{level **Bark Skin (2).** Your Bark Skin' Defense bonus increases to STRx3. : **Savage Bloom (4).** Your Savage Bloom bonus is now 4d(SD). : **Secondary Stat Increase**. +1 DEX or INT. }} {{level **Shifting Seasons.** (1/encounter) At the start of your turn, you may switch to a different Seasonal Adaptation than your current one. }} {{level **Epic Boon**. Choose an Epic Boon (see pg. 23 of the GM's Guide). }} {{level **Ancient Fury.** +1 to any 2 of your stats. When you expend a Seed Die for Savage Bloom, you may expend a second Seed Die of the same size to double Savage Bloom's damage bonus. }} {{pageNumber}} \page {{classSpread}} # Horticulture Abilities {{note2,wide
Meld Into Tree
(1/Safe Rest) Action: Meld into an adjacent plant until the start of your next turn. You cannot take damage or use reactions during this time. If there are no nearby plants, become one. }} {{note2,wide
Rampant Growth
(1/turn) After you use Savage Bloom, you may grow your biggest Seed Die one size. }} {{note2,wide
Vital Bloom
(1/encounter) After you use Savage Bloom, gain temp HP equal to the damage rolled. }} {{note2,wide
Shared Bark
Reaction: When an ally within Reach 6 takes damage, expend a Seed Die and reduce that damage by STR×2. }} {{note2,wide
Prepared Sapling
When you roll Initiative, gain a Seed Die at d6 instead of a d4. }} {{note2,wide
Ingrain
Action: Gain temp HP equal to STR×LVL. You are Restrained until the end of your next turn, and cannot be moved aginst your will. Any remaining temp HP is lost once you're no longer Restrained. }} {{note2,wide
Efficient Cultivation
You may use Cultivate Flora twice per turn instead of once. }} {{note2,wide
Branching Vines
When you hit with Thorn Whip, you may expend a Seed Die: deal the same damage to a second creature adjacent to your target. }} {{note2,wide
Bramble Lash
On hit with Thorn Whip, instead of dealing damage, you may Grapple the target if they are your size or smaller. If they're larger than you, move onto them and gain the Riding condition. }} {{note2,wide
Sap Reserve
(1/encounter) Action: Expend a Seed Die: roll it and regain that much mana. }} {{pageNumber}} \page {{classSpread}} {{classImage ![seasonaladaptations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Applesmacks/NimbleHomebrewProjects/refs/heads/main/Greenspeaker/Seasons.svg) }} # Seasonal Adaptations {{note2,wide
Spring's Rejuvination
(1/encounter) When you use Savage Bloom, you may also heal yourself or an ally within Reach 6 for the same amount. }} {{note2,wide
Summer's Growth
(1/encounter) When you use Savage Bloom, you may increase the size of the expended Seed Die for the purpose of resolution. }} {{note2,wide
Autumn's Harvest
Whenever an enemy drops to 0 HP within Reach 6, gain a new Seed Die at d4, even if this exceeds your max count. }} {{note2,wide
Winter's Stillness
Enemies who start their turn within Reach 4 of you are Slowed until the end of their turn. }} {{pageNumber}} \page # Greenspeaker Spells {{note2,wide
Thorn Whip Cantrip, Single Target 1 Action
Range: 6. Damage: Seed Die (of choice) + WIL. }} {{note2,wide
Dense Undergrowth Tier 1, AoE 1 Action
Range: 4, 3x3 AoE. The area becomes difficult terrain until the start of your next turn. }} {{note2,wide
Corpse Flower Tier 1, AoE 2 Actions
Reach: 1, AoE. Damage: 2d8, Poisoned until the end of their next turn. }} {{note2,wide
Bindweed Tier 2 0 Actions
Castable only while Defending. Vines burst from the ground beneath the attacker, Restraining them until they escape. }} {{note2,wide
Unstable Oak Tier 2, AoE 2 Actions
Line: 4, AoE. Damage: 2d10. If 15+ damage is rolled, targets are knocked Prone. }} {{note2,wide
Confuddling Spores Tier 3, AoE 2 Actions
Reach: 4, 3x3 AoE. Enemies in the area must succeed on a WIL save. On failure, at the start of their next turn, their first attack must target another creature within their reach or range, chosen by you. }} {{note2,wide
Tangled Thicket Tier 3, AoE 2 Actions
Reach: 6, 3x3 AoE. Damage: 4d8 and Restrained on a failed DEX save. On save, half damage only. }} {{note2,wide
Shade Canopy Tier 4, AoE 2 Actions
Reach: 3. Allies within Reach gain Invisible until they attack or until the start of your next turn. }} {{note2,wide
Heartwood Spike Tier 4, Single Target 2 Actions
Reach: 6. Damage: 3d10+20. If you roll 40+ damage, the target's armor is reduced by one step for the rest of the encounter (before damage is applied). }} {{note2,wide
Wrathful Grove Tier 5, AoE 3 Actions
Reach: 12, 6x6 AoE. Damage: 4d6+20. Until the end of your next turn, allies in the area have advantage and enemies have disadvantage on attacks. }} {{pageNumber}} \page {{classSpread}} {{classImage ![overgrowth](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Applesmacks/NimbleHomebrewProjects/refs/heads/main/Greenspeaker/Overgrowth.svg) }} {{subclassTag}} {{wide
VOICE OF
OVERGROWTH
}} {{sublevel **Twin Growth.** You may have Cultivate Flora grow two Seed Dice one size each, instead of growing one Seed Die two sizes. }} {{sublevel **Accretion.** Action: Expend a Seed Die at your maximum size — deal WIL d(SD) damage to a creature within Reach 6 (ignoring armor) . }} {{sublevel **Cyclical Growth.** (1/turn) Whenever you expend a Seed Die, grow all your other Seed Dice one size. }} {{sublevel **Bountiful Overgrowth.** Your max Seed Die size is now d20. }} {{pageNumber}} \page {{classSpread}} {{classImage ![decay](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Applesmacks/NimbleHomebrewProjects/refs/heads/main/Greenspeaker/Decay.svg) }} {{subclassTag}} {{wide
VOICE OF
DECAY
}} {{sublevel **Wilt.** (1/turn) Action: Roll all of your Seed Dice at their current sizes and deal that much damage to each creature within Reach 2. If 10+ damage is rolled, those creatures are Poisoned until the end of their next turn. Then, decay your Seed Dice by one size each. : **Putrid Lash.** When you hit with Thorn Whip, you may decay any number of Seed Dice by one size each. For each die decayed this way, increase your Thorn Whip's Primary Die by 1. }} {{note,wide **Decay.** When you decay a Seed Die, swap the die for the next smaller size. The die size order is d4 <- d6 <- d8 <- d10 <- d12. A Seed Die that decayed in a turn does not grow at the end of that turn. }} {{sublevel **Corpseroot.** (1/round) While Dying, you can cast Thorn Whip for free, and ignore the STR save for this cast. }} {{sublevel **Acidic Thorns.** Your Thorn Whip gains Vicious and on crit: the target is Poisoned until the end of their next turn }} {{sublevel **Master of Decay.** If you would gain a Wound, you may expend a Seed Die of size d8 or larger to ignore that Wound. }} {{pageNumber}} \page {{classSpread}} {{classImage ![gardening](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Applesmacks/NimbleHomebrewProjects/refs/heads/main/Greenspeaker/Gardening.svg) }} {{subclassTag}} {{wide
VOICE OF
GARDENING
}} {{sublevel **Bountiful Harvest** (1/encounter) 2 Actions: Heal yourself or an adjacent ally WIL d6. : **Leave the Roots.** When you would expend a Seed Dice, it shrinks to d4 instead of being lost. }} {{sublevel **Careful Curation.** When you cast a spell or use an ability that affects an area, up to WIL creatures of your choice are unaffected. }} {{sublevel **Peaceful Garden** (1/Safe Rest) When you and your allies expend Hit Dice while Catching a Breath, each character may maximize the value of up to WIL dice. }} {{sublevel **Hedge Wall.** 2 Actions: Expend a Seed Die. Create a wall in a number of contiguous spaces equal to WIL, starting within Reach 6. It lasts until the start of your next turn and cannot be passed by walking creatures. A creature within the wall when it's created is pushed to a side of your choice and takes WIL d(SD) damage. }} {{pageNumber}} \page {{classSpread}} {{classImage ![mutation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Applesmacks/NimbleHomebrewProjects/refs/heads/main/Greenspeaker/Mutation.svg) }} {{subclassTag}} {{wide
VOICE OF
MUTATION
}} {{sublevel **Mutagenic Surge** Whenever you use Savage Bloom, roll a d4. The associated effect occurs:
- 1. The bonus damage instead targets a random creature within Reach 4 of your original target. This may include allies. - 2. Gain advantage on your next Thorn Whip or Heartwood Spike before the end of your next turn. - 3. Gain temp HP equal to WIL. - 4. Grow one of your Seed Dice one size, or gain a new one at d4 if you have none.
}} {{sublevel **Plants With Teeth**. The first time each turn a creature takes damage or gains a condition from one of your spells, they also take WIL damage (ignoring armor). }} {{sublevel **Random Sampling.** (1/turn) Action: Roll a d4 for each of your Seed Dice. Each die becomes a new result:
- 1. d4. - 2. d6. - 3. d8. - 4. d10.
}} {{sublevel **Inject Plant Material.** When you deal the Savage Bloom bonus, you may lose half your current HP instead of expending a Seed Die. If you do, treat the die's size as your maximum possible Seed Die size. }} {{pageNumber}} \page {{classSpread}} {{classImage ![Mycelium](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Applesmacks/NimbleHomebrewProjects/refs/heads/main/Greenspeaker/Mycelium.svg) }} {{subclassTag}} {{wide {{wide
VOICE OF
MYCELIUM
}} }} {{sublevel **Spores.** When you deal damage with Savage Bloom, the target(s) gain Spored. While Spored, you always know its location, even if hidden or invisible. : **Devouring Growth.** Whenever a Spored creature dies, Cultivate Flora for free. }} {{sublevel **Fungal Bloom.** When you cast a Greenspeaker spell, it may also manifest from a second, unoccupied space within Reach 6. The second manifestation deals half damage. {{note,wide *A creature can only be affected by one of your spells at a time.* }} }} {{sublevel **Fibrous Network.** Fungal Bloom's second manifestation may instead originate from any Spored creature within Reach 12. If it does, it deals full damage instead of half. }} {{sublevel **The Network Awakens.** (1/Safe Rest) When you cast a Greenspeaker spell, it also manifests from the space of every Spored creature within Reach 12, at full damage. }} {{pageNumber}} \page {{classSpread}} {{classImage ![Pollen](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Applesmacks/NimbleHomebrewProjects/refs/heads/main/Greenspeaker/Pollen.svg) }} {{subclassTag}} {{wide
VOICE OF
POLLEN
}} {{sublevel **Pollen Burst.** Action: Expend a Seed Die. Until the start of your next turn, an ally within Reach 6 deals an additional 1d(SD) damage on their attacks. An ally can only be affected by one instance of Pollen Burst at a time. : **Nectar Guard.** When an ally affected by Pollen Burst Defends, they gain +WIL Defense (use your WIL value). }} {{sublevel **Blossoming Strike.** Whenever an ally benefitting from Pollen Burst scores a critical hit, Cultivate Flora for free. }} {{sublevel **Potent Pollen** Pollen Burst instead affects all allies within Reach 6. }} {{sublevel **Full Bloom.** Before an ally benefitting from Pollen Burst rolls any dice, you may replace one with a d20. Once per ally, per encounter. }} {{pageNumber}} \page {{classSpread}} {{classImage ![Seedbeds](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Applesmacks/NimbleHomebrewProjects/refs/heads/main/Greenspeaker/Seedbed.svg) }} {{subclassTag}} {{wide
VOICE OF
SEEDBEDS
}} {{sublevel **Sow Sprouts.** Action: Expend a Seed Die to grow WIL Sprouts, each with an attack die equal to the expended die's size, in unoccupied spaces within Reach 6. You cannot use this ability while you have any Sprouts alive. : **Command the Grove.** (1/turn) Action: Command your Sprouts to move 4 and attack. }} {{sublevel **Cycle of Life.** Whenever a Sprout dies, it leaves Difficult Terrain in its space until the start of your next turn. : **Hypergrowth.** Action: Choose any number of your Sprouts. They each attack an adjacent creature, then are destroyed. }} {{sublevel **Bramble Ambush.** (1/round) When you Sow Seedlings, your Sprouts may immediately make one attack each as part of that action. }} {{sublevel **Thorned Bloom.** Whenever you Cultivate Flora, also grow all of your living Sprouts' attack die one size. }} {{pageNumber}} \page {{classSpread}} {{classImage ![Seedbeds](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Applesmacks/NimbleHomebrewProjects/refs/heads/main/Greenspeaker/Ironbark.svg) }} {{subclassTag}} {{wide
VOICE OF
IRONBARK
}} {{sublevel **Ironwood Strikes.** You may use Savage Bloom on Staff attacks. When you do, double the attack's STR bonus. }} {{sublevel **Blunt-Force Growth.** Whenever you hit with a Staff attack, you may grow one of your Seed Dice one size. }} {{sublevel **Sweeping Bough.** When you use Savage Bloom on a Staff attack, you may deal the Savage Bloom bonus damage to another enemy adjacent to your target. }} {{sublevel **Timber!** (1/turn) When you attack with a Staff, you may change the damage die to be 1d20. }} {{pageNumber}}
